title: Integration by parts for a function C^1 on the ball, via a bump cutoff
statement:
Let n ∈ ℕ, R ∈ ℝ, B := B̆_R(0) ⊆ ℝⁿ (ℝⁿ = Euclid n), e_i := EuclideanSpace.single i 1, and D = fderiv ℝ. Let h : ℝⁿ → ℝ be of class C¹ on B (ContDiffOn ℝ 1 h B; nothing is assumed off B). Let Φ_0, …, Φ_{n−1} : ℝⁿ → ℝ be C¹, each with compact support and tsupport Φ_i ⊆ B. Then
∫_B Σ_i Dh(x)(e_i)·Φ_i(x) dx = −∫_B h(x)·Σ_i DΦ_i(x)(e_i) dx.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (R : ℝ) (h : Euclid n → ℝ) (Φ : Fin n → Euclid n → ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ 1 h (ball (0 : Euclid n) R) → (∀ i, ContDiff ℝ 1 (Φ i)) → (∀ i, HasCompactSupport (Φ i)) → (∀ i, tsupport (Φ i) ⊆ ball (0 : Euclid n) R) → ∫ x in ball (0 : Euclid n) R, ∑ i : Fin n, fderiv ℝ h x (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)) * Φ i x = -∫ x in ball (0 : Euclid n) R, h x * ∑ i : Fin n, fderiv ℝ (Φ i) x (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ))
